name: pastevault
description: Ask the user for secrets without them entering the chat, use them via pastevault run, and share text and files end-to-end encrypted. Needs the pastevault CLI on PATH.

settings.name: PasteVault server
settings.description: API URL of a self-hosted PasteVault server. Leave empty for https://api.pastevault.dev.

settings.name: PasteVault API token
settings.description: Optional API token (pv_pat_...). Leave empty to use the login stored by pastevault login.
